content:
Current resume state

Updated 2026-09-10 UTC. CSP3 is active. Eight of 38 tasks are complete. Twenty-one PRs merged. Unmerged work receives no completion credit.

The availability proof owns the D27 through D29 revision. Thirty-three focused tests and four pipeline tests pass. Full checks run in session 78012. Minimum-Go checks use session 73444. Preserve both running sessions. The current code edits are uncommitted.

Continue scoped membership work in /tmp/starmap-scoped-membership-2026-09-09, branch codex/catalog-scoped-membership, based on merged fee76cc9. The scope proof owns this work. Health, reset recovery, and 68 integration test events pass. The full runtime suite passes 703 test events with the required twenty-minute limit. The full acquisition rerun passes 92 test events after the unsupported-schema fixture repair.

The draft preserves local and upstream scope receipts through publication and restart. Local directory migration and upstream scope replacement checks pass. The scope proof records passing retention, compatibility, and minimum-Go checks. Publisher reservation and HTTPS trust checks pass at local commit 373fa2ca. Commit 70e260d6 repairs the fixture pin. Documentation commit 2290162f names generation validation at activation.

The earlier full run passed 719 runtime, 92 acquisition, and 644 reconciler test events. New artifact import tests reproduced lost membership scopes. Commit 8a4c14d9 passes eight focused events on each supported Go toolchain and all 100 acquisition test events. The prior review passed. D27 through D29 require a revised implementation and fresh review.

The acceptance verifier ended with all 50 cases unverified. Its summary omits per-command results. Its snapshot predates the partial-empty registration and artifact import repair. The scope proof preserves these limits and separate command evidence. Use JSON output for the next detailed qualification.

Local commit 6517c69b registers A08 partial and empty inventory behavior. All six registered commands and 73 verifier tests pass. Scoped deletion policy and model alias acceptance remain incomplete.

Membership authority controls complete scoped availability evidence. D27 forbids catalog deletion from ordinary provider absence.

The A20 registration proof records 34 passing commands across five Starmap subcases. The Starport ingestion subcase remains unverified. Commit 6a600fea is in /tmp/starmap-source-acceptance-2026-09-09, branch codex/catalog-source-acceptance. PR #143 carries the rebased registration.

The earlier final gate failed on CLI application and runtime timeouts. The reviewed serial scheduling repair preserves the tests and deadline. All six native jobs pass in fresh CI 34426991461. The final verification job remains active. Automatic merge waits for required checks.

Read the CSP3 contract and remaining acceptance audit after the delivery checks. Full A08, A20, and released-pair acceptance remain incomplete. D25 requires explicit inference-profile scope links. D27 rejects automatic deletion from provider absence. Explicit scoped removal and automatic-routing exclusion remain required. The rename-window decision remains pending. The goal block preserves all 38 tasks, 50 cases, and 324 required subcases.

Starport remains at clean d45bb30 in /tmp/starport-readme-merged-2026-09-08, branch codex/catalog-starmap-main. It passes 32/33 gates. V01 requires a stable Starmap release and separate publication authority.

Canonical plan branch: codex/catalog-qualification. The maintenance proof preserves prior resume instructions and verifies unchanged task contracts. Existing authority permits reviewed pushes and merges. Releases and hosted publication require separate authority.
